name: retained messages changed while a node is away
comments: Two retained messages are held by every node. node5 (theater) goes; while it is down one of them
is replaced and the other cleared, on node3 (thinker11). node5 comes back and must give a new
subscriber the replacement, and nothing for the cleared topic: it reads the retained messages from
the storage as it starts, and does not bring back what it held. On the default test cluster of
test_cluster.sh, run from thinker10. xmq_sub -v prints each message with its payload in brackets,
and 'Received N message(s).' at the end; an empty file published retained clears a topic.

timeline.command: xmq_pub -h thinker10 -p 2884 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -R -i cluster-retained-publisher -t cluster/test/retained-replaced -m held-before --quiet
xmq_pub -h thinker10 -p 2884 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -R -i cluster-retained-publisher -t cluster/test/retained-cleared -m will-be-cleared --quiet
xmq_pub -h thinker11 -p 2886 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -R -i cluster-retained-publisher -t cluster/test/retained-replaced -m replaced-while-away --quiet
xmq_pub -h thinker11 -p 2886 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -R -i cluster-retained-publisher -t cluster/test/retained-cleared -f /dev/null --quiet
xmq_sub -h theater -p 2888 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -i cluster-retained-subscriber -t cluster/test/retained-replaced -C 1 -W 5 -v | grep -q '\[replaced-while-away\]'
xmq_sub -h theater -p 2888 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -i cluster-retained-subscriber -t cluster/test/retained-cleared -W 3 | grep -q 'Received 0 message'
xmq_pub -h thinker10 -p 2884 -u user -P User-Secret1 -V 5 -q 1 -R -i cluster-retained-publisher -t cluster/test/retained-replaced -f /dev/null --quiet

checks.name: the cleared topic is gone from the storage
